summary: Full backend + frontend regression for CONTRACT SOURCE OF TRUTH (PO msg 782, GT-INFISSIEXPRESS-2026-09-V1). Ran existing test_contract_source_of_truth.py (9/9 passed) covering canonical structure (31 articles, order preserved), clause approval preservation, unknown version fail-closed, summary consistency (14 sections all with source_articles), quote PDF summary-only, contract invariance (IDENTICAL text + hash), contract PDF full articles + signatures + Foro di Lecco + 1341/1342 + Firma per esteso >=5, economic parity (subtotal/vat/total/lines/vat_regime=22/payment_terms match, no margin/internal_cost leak), and ACCEPTED freeze (quote_revision_id ends #R00, accepted_at equal, snapshot_id shared with quote). Added new test_contract_legacy_fallback.py (2/2 passed): legacy contracts (108 in DB) still return 200 on PDF preview (canonical fallback) and terms-verify returns status CONTRACT_TERMS_SOURCE_MISSING when quote_snapshot.general_terms is absent. Article testids use suffixes like ART_2_BIS (underscore for non-numeric suffixes) which matches component logic.
critical_code_review_comments: Article data-testid uses `a.code` (e.g. gt-article-ART_2_BIS with underscore) rather than the article number '2-bis'. Requested testids like gt-article-ART_1..ART_24 are all present but non-numeric suffixes (bis/ter/quater) render as ART_2_BIS/ART_3_TER/ART_3_QUATER — worth documenting so future E2E tests use the correct code pattern.

GET /api/contracts?limit=100 list payload does not include quote_snapshot; needed detail GET per item to detect legacy contracts. Consider exposing `has_frozen_general_terms` boolean flag on the list for faster admin filters.
